Results.ReviewText:
This is the 4th E-310 that I purchased.  One as a house warming gift, 2 for rental properties, and one for my main home.  It's well built, lights all the time and does a great job.  
Assembly hint:
When assembling it, don't completely tighten the screws until you have the grill bottom in place.  If you completely tighten them I've found that as you go along, other pieces don't fit right. The first time I put one of these together, I thought there was something wrong with the parts, but after loosening a whole bunch of screws, I was able to make everything fit properly.
Results.Title: Great Grill

ClientResponses.Response:
We are sorry to hear about the connection issue with your new Spirit II E-310, but we are here to help!

Your grill should be able to reach the same high temperature we expect from all of our grills, at least 450 F. If your grill is not getting that hot, we would suggest starting by double-checking your current gas pressure. The gas pressure provided to the grill is of the utmost importance, it affects the performance of the burner tube(s).

Here is a helpful link for review:
https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023605032-How-hot-should-my-gas-grill-get-

Please lookout for an email from our Support team, we would like to hear more about this experience. Thank you!

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
